_doc: Races (DESIGN §2): stats, temperament, a trait, a synergy when 2 or more share the party, and how the race is first met. Trait and synergy behaviours are implemented in code by id; their numbers live here. Unlock kinds: start, delves (n delves made), cleared (a tier cleared), reached (a tier unlocked), built (n Torchwatch upgrades), memorial (n heroes fallen), later (a tier not built yet).

trait.name: Stoneblood
trait.about: Shrugs off the first critical hit each fight.

trait.name: Keen Eye
trait.about: The first attack each fight always lands a critical hit.

synergy.name: Starsight
synergy.about: The Leader sees one room further.

trait.name: Lucky
trait.about: Once per delve, survives a killing blow at 1 HP.

synergy.name: Warband
synergy.about: Each kill gives the rest of the party energy.

unlock.hint: An orc band drinks at the Inn, waiting to see if you're worth following.

synergy.name: Clockwork
synergy.about: Skills recharge 10% faster for the whole party.

unlock.hint: Gnome tinkers come to work on a growing Torchwatch.

trait.name: Scavenger
trait.about: +25% coin from the pack while a goblin lives.

synergy.name: Mob
synergy.about: +5% attack speed per goblin in the party.

unlock.hint: Goblins skulk in the Crypt Shallows' deeper floors.

trait.name: Regrowth
trait.about: Heals 1% of max HP each second in a fight.

unlock.hint: Met in the Flooded Ruins (Tier IV).

trait.name: Pounce
trait.about: Its first action each fight has no wind-up.

synergy.name: Prowl
synergy.about: The party can't be ambushed in the dark.

unlock.hint: Catfolk traders come once Torchwatch has a name.

trait.name: Spore Burst
trait.about: Poisons nearby enemies when it dies.

synergy.name: Mycelium
synergy.about: Rest and field dressing heal twice as much.

unlock.hint: The mushroom folk live in the Fungal Caverns.

trait.name: Unliving
trait.about: Rises once per delve at 25% HP. A cleric's holy healing can't touch it.

unlock.hint: When enough names are on the memorial, some of the dead come back.

trait.name: Ironframe
trait.about: Healing doesn't work on it; it's repaired at Torchwatch instead.

synergy.name: Assembly Line
synergy.about: +15% armour per construct in the party.

unlock.hint: Built in the Dwarven Forge (Tier V).

trait.name: Aloft
trait.about: Hovers over hazards; melee blows often miss it.

unlock.hint: Found in the Fey Grove (Tier VI).

trait.name: Blood Pact
trait.about: Can unleash its ultimate early by paying in blood.

synergy.name: Hellfire
synergy.about: The party's burns last 2 seconds longer.
